name: prompt-695
image_purpose: Portrait and fashion lookbook reference for consistent beauty storytelling across varied crops and moods.

prompt.project_info: Create a 3x3 portrait editorial grid with one consistent approved adult fictional woman in a light blue sleeveless dress and pastel-blue studio setting.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional woman with consistent face and natural features, wearing a light blue sleeveless dress, understated makeup, and softly expressive eyes.
composition_elements: Close-up beauty crop with cheek and lips.
Eye-focused crop with soft pastel background.
Hands and collarbone detail with tasteful fashion framing.
Seated three-quarter portrait in the light blue dress.
Gentle profile with a reflective, non-distressing mood.
Soft full portrait with dress silhouette visible.
Final close-up with calm expression and consistent styling.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio light, pastel blue and pale neutral backgrounds, delicate highlights, quiet cinematic mood, controlled contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic fashion portrait photography, high-resolution skin and fabric texture, realistic hands, consistent adult identity across nine panels, clean 3x3 grid, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic 3x3 portrait editorial grid, one consistent adult fictional woman in a light blue sleeveless dress, pastel-blue studio backgrounds, varied close-ups, eye detail, cheek and lips, black-and-white panel, hands and collarbone detail, seated portrait, gentle reflective profile, soft full portrait, delicate cinematic diffused lighting, natural skin, consistent face and styling, tasteful fashion lookbook, no text, no watermark.
